I am old now and my bones are not strong like before, but I know this small piece of land well. I will put cow dung on it like I always do, and plant the seed I kept from last year’s harvest. I do not have money for the chemical fertilizer or sprays from the shop, and the rains have always been enough for maize on this plot. My grandchildren will help me with the digging and weeding when they are not at school, so we do not need to pay workers.
